name: genudo
description: Connect Claude to Genudo — build and manage pipeline-aware AI agents for any messaging channel, with integrations and company knowledge.
long_description: Genudo is the platform to build AI agents for any communication or sequence-based channel — WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, LinkedIn, email, and more. Build pipeline-aware agents with integration capabilities (webhooks to your CRM, Zapier, Make, or n8n) and company-knowledge access, all managed from one platform, one inbox, and one analytics dashboard. This connector lets Claude create, edit, automate, and analyze those agents end to end.

token.title: Genudo Token
token.description: Get it from your Genudo account: API Keys & Tokens → Create token, with the mcp:use scope. Shown only once — copy it at creation.

base_url.title: Base URL (advanced)
base_url.description: Only change this for a self-hosted Genudo instance.

workdir.title: Working folder
workdir.description: Where local pipeline mirrors, version snapshots and cached guides are written. Leave empty to use the current directory.
